mapper.insert: INSERT INTO faq (category_code, question, answer_html, answer_text, sort_order, status, metadata, created_by) VALUES (#{categoryCode}, #{question}, #{answerHtml}, #{answerText}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{metadata}::jsonb, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE faq SET category_code = #{categoryCode}, question = #{question}, answer_html = #{answerHtml}, answer_text = #{answerText}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE faq SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
